title: Fan-in after embedding circuits
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $D_1,\ldots,D_r$ be a finite list of circuits with $m$ inputs, and suppose each circuit is well formed and every gate in it has at most two inputs. For any list of source vertices and any natural number $L$, every gate in the circuit obtained by embedding this list is well formed and has at most two inputs.
hypotheses_covered: Every circuit in the list is well formed
Every gate in each circuit has at most two inputs
An arbitrary list of source vertices
